task.description: Hard-gate REQ-203's implementation against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md INV-1..INV-8 before REVIEWER's idiom/scope-creep pass.
acceptance_criteria: Every INV-1..INV-8 assessed as APPLIES or NOT-APPLICABLE with reasoning
Every APPLIES invariant verified PASS/FAIL with the actual diff read, not summarized

result.summary: PASS on all applicable invariants. INV-1 (tenant isolation) APPLIES and PASSES: every query/insert in lib/letflow/repository/activation.ex is prefix-scoped (resolve/3, activate_group/4's upsert/history/audit steps, list_history/4); tenant_id derived from TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 at write time, never caller-supplied; migration's three tables are created only inside `if prefix() do` and registered in Letflow.TenantProvisioning's @tenant_scoped_migration_manifest. FOR UPDATE lock in upsert_activation_pointer/8 is prefix-scoped by construction (schema-per-tenant: the locked query cannot reach another tenant's physically separate schema). UNIQUE (tenant_id, artifact_kind, artifact_name) confirmed as a real Postgres unique index (AC4), not an app-level check. All three ON DELETE RESTRICT FKs (active_version_id, previous_version_id, new_version_id) confirmed present with no accidental CASCADE/SET NULL (AC9). Audit.append_multi/4 cross-write confirmed scoped to the same prefix, actor_id correctly set to the real activator, resource_id to the artifact's own id -- no cross-tenant or misattributed data. DB CHECK (rationale <> '') confirmed present via raw execute/1 DDL on both artifact_activation_history and artifact_activation_groups. No secrets/PII on any new column. git diff --stat scoped to lib/letflow_web/router*/routers* is empty -- no route/controller added (AC11). The shared artifact_kind refactor (Letflow.Repository.ArtifactKind) is confirmed behavior-preserving for REQ-202: identical seven-atom enum value list/order, only a new backward-compatible delegate added, no tenant-scoping change. INV-2/INV-3/INV-5 correctly NOT-APPLICABLE (S4/S5 not started). INV-4/INV-7/INV-8 all APPLY and PASS (no hardcoded secrets; migration's execute/1 interpolates only the migration-time, framework-resolved schema name, not tenant/user-controlled data; no bare {:ok, _} = pattern that can raise on realistic external-I/O failure). Full detail in handoffs/WF02-REQ203-20260831/security-review-req203.md.
